sections.name: File setup, FamilyModule
sections.title: Module setup and global sharing
sections.what: Lists the controller and service, and marks the family feature as shared across the app so other features can reach its service.
sections.why: Likely reason: other features may need the family service, but the code does not say which ones.
sections.watch_out: Because the module is global, a missing provider can show up far from this file, so check the app's root module when startup fails.

summary: Packages the family controller and family service, and makes the family service available to the rest of the app.
purpose: Registers the family feature so its routes and logic load when the app starts.
why: Likely reason: marking the module global lets other features use the family service without importing this module. The code does not say which features need it.
how: 1) Load the controller and the service. 2) Register both. 3) Export the service. 4) Mark the module global, so any other module can use the service without importing this one.
inputs: None directly. The service needs the database, audit and notification services, which must be provided elsewhere.
outputs: A loadable module that exposes the family routes and the family service.
risks: A global module hides where a dependency comes from, which makes changes harder to trace. The service also needs the audit and notification providers, which this file does not import.
debug: If the app fails to start because a family service dependency is missing, check that the audit and notification modules are loaded. If family routes return not found, confirm the app loads this module.
